subject: english
prompt: My aunt moved to a new city. I call her every Sunday and send photos of our garden. What is the main idea?

options.text: I keep in touch with a family member who lives far away.
I moved to the new city every Sunday.
My aunt grows our garden at school.
We stopped communicating after she moved.

answer.explanation: Weekly calls and shared photos show continued contact with the aunt after she moved away.

solutionStrategy: Combine the repeated action and the reason for it to form the relationship-level main idea.
solutionSteps: Identify the relationship: aunt and speaker.
Notice the distance: she moved to a new city.
Collect the contact actions: calls and photos.
Reject movement, school gardening, and stopped contact claims.
Choose A because it summarizes the ongoing relationship.
